finding.text: The diff appends about 90 `{"file":"session-…/page.jsonl","gone":true}` lines to the day indexes `ai/2026/10/09`, `10/12`, `10/07`, `10/02` and others, but those session folders still exist on main (e.g. `ai/2026/10/12/session-fbe81ab2/` is present). This is the worktree's file watcher, which has no copy of those generated folders, so merging this would hide real sessions on main. The shot already shows it: shots/…ai-2026-10-12/1920.png, the day page reads "Nothing here yet." Drop every `page.jsonl`/`files.jsonl` hunk outside `ext/Query`, `core/Page` and this task's folder before merging.

Requirement 3 asks for before/after on the Sessions page itself, but no shot of `/framework/ai/sessions/?source=node` reached review. Only `build/measure/proof-*.png` exist, and the shots folder holds the Query page plus unrelated day pages. So the page that changed is unreviewed at either width (Requirements 3, page 1).

The Query page's first view is just two cards (Overview, "Spec in, result out"), and the live demo sits one click down. At 1920 that leaves 88% of the screen empty (layout.json `empty 0.881`), so the demo could go on level 1 (page: show, don't tell).

Remote mode is opt-in (`?source=node`) because buckets, nesting and provider are not at parity yet. The before numbers are not like-for-like (main site vs. a private server), and `server-query.md` says so honestly. The like-for-like gain is about 310 KB of transfer and half the JS heap, and time to first row did not change.

Live updates work as the brief asks: `QueryServer.changed` pushes `query_row` for shown ids only, plus a throttled `query_stale`. One small mismatch: `QueryClient`'s header comment documents `row: (qid, item)`, but it calls `on_row(item)`.
Coordination did not happen: STATE.md says Servex refused direct messages to @mastermind-data-grid and @mastermind-perf-system, so notes went to their inboxes instead. STATE.md still shows Build ⬜.
